WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CAST(#{COMPANY_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT) AS COMPANY_CODE ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{vendor,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS VENDOR ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS ITEM_CODES ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY( BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*' ) END AS ITEM_CODE_ARRAY ,TO_DATE( NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{search_from_date,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ) AS SEARCH_FROM_DATE ,TO_DATE( NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{search_to_date,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ) AS SEARCH_TO_DATE ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{importanceYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS IMPORTANCE_YN ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{includeRegisteredYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS INCLUDE_REGISTERED_YN ,COALESCE( CAST( NULLIF( BTRIM(CAST(#{blanketExpiryDays,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '' ) AS INTEGER ), 0 ) AS BLANKET_EXPIRY_DAYS )
SELECT DISTINCT IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC" ,IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(EC.ISSUE_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "ISSUE_DATE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(EC.APPLY_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "APPLY_DATE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(EC.END_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE" ,PL.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" ,VE.VENDOR_NAME AS "VENDOR_NAME" ,CD.CODE_NAME AS "SUBMIT_STATUS" ,DI.DIVISION_NAME AS "DIVISION_NAME" ,PL.DIVISION_CODE AS "DIVISION_CODE" ,VE.SEND_RECEIVE_IDENTIFIER_CODE AS "SEND_RECEIVE_IDENTIFIER_CODE" ,EC.COO_CERTIFY_NO AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO"
FROM PO_LEDGER PL
CROSS JOIN PARAMS P
INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN VENDOR VE ON VE.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
INNER JOIN DIVISION DI ON DI.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND DI.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,MAX(ECD.ISSUE_DATE) AS ISSUE_DATE ,MAX(ECD.APPLY_DATE) AS APPLY_DATE ,MAX(ECD.END_DATE) AS END_DATE ,ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO WHERE ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' GROUP BY ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS ) EC ON EC.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND EC.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND EC.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND EC.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CD.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'SS' AND CD.CODE = CAST(EC.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AND CD.DELETE_YN = 'N'
WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE
AND ( P.ITEM_CODES IS NULL OR CAST(IM.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.ITEM_CODE_ARRAY) )
AND ( P.VENDOR IS NULL OR VE.VENDOR_NAME ILIKE '%' || P.VENDOR || '%' )
AND ( P.SEARCH_FROM_DATE IS NULL OR CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS DATE) >= P.SEARCH_FROM_DATE )
AND ( P.SEARCH_TO_DATE IS NULL OR CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS DATE) <= P.SEARCH_TO_DATE )
AND ( P.IMPORTANCE_YN IS NULL OR VE.IMPORTANCE_MGT_YN = P.IMPORTANCE_YN )
/* 기등록 증명서 포함 Y : 등록/미등록 전체 Y가 아니면 : 미등록만 */ AND ( P.INCLUDE_REGISTERED_YN = 'Y' OR PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NULL OR PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO = '' )
AND ( P.BLANKET_EXPIRY_DAYS = 0 OR ( EC.END_DATE IS NOT NULL AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(NULLIF(EC.END_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD') - P.BLANKET_EXPIRY_DAYS AND TO_DATE(NULLIF(EC.END_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ) )
ORDER BY "VENDOR_CODE" ,"DIVISION_CODE" ,"ITEM_CODE" ,"SUBMIT_STATUS"

WITH BASE_ITEM AS ( SELECT DISTINCT PL.COMPANY_CODE ,PL.DIVISION_CODE ,PL.VENDOR_CODE ,PL.ITEM_CODE FROM PO_LEDGER PL INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE INNER JOIN VENDOR VE ON VE.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE INNER JOIN DIVISION DI ON DI.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND DI.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = CAST(#{COMPANY_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT) ), LATEST_CERTIFY AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON ( ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ) ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,CAST(ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AS SUBMIT_STATUS ,CD.CODE_NAME AS SUBMIT_STATUS_NAME ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END AS ISSUE_DATE ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.APPLY_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.APPLY_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END AS APPLY_DATE ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.END_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.END_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END AS END_DATE FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'SS' AND CD.CODE = CAST(ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AND CD.DELETE_YN = 'N' WHERE ECM.COMPANY_CODE = CAST(#{COMPANY_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT) AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' ORDER BY ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.END_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.END_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END DESC NULLS LAST ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END DESC NULLS LAST ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE LC.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NULL ) AS "unregisteredItemCount" ,COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE LC.SUBMIT_STATUS_NAME = '제출완료' ) AS "submittedItemCount" ,COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE LC.END_DATE BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + 30 ) AS "expiringWithin30DaysItemCount" ,COUNT(*) AS "totalItemCount" FROM BASE_ITEM BI LEFT JOIN LATEST_CERTIFY LC ON LC.COMPANY_CODE = BI.COMPANY_CODE AND LC.DIVISION_CODE = BI.DIVISION_CODE AND LC.VENDOR_CODE = BI.VENDOR_CODE AND LC.ITEM_CODE = BI.ITEM_CODE

choose.when: SELECT ECD.DIVISION_CODE AS "DIVISION_CODE" ,ECD.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" ,ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO" ,ECD.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC" ,ECD.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME" ,ECD.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,ECD.RULE_CODE AS "RULE_CODE" ,ECD.RULE_CODE AS "RULE_CODE_NM" ,ECD.RVC_RATE AS "RVC_RATE" ,ECD.COO_YN AS "COO_YN" ,CASE WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' THEN '충족' WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'N' THEN '불충족' ELSE '' END AS "COO_YN_NM" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(ECD.APPLY_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(ECD.END_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "COVER_DATE" ,ECD.COO_NATION AS "COO_NATION" ,COALESCE(CD.CODE_NAME, '') AS "COO_NATION_NM" ,'' AS "NO_CODE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(ECD.ISSUE_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "ISSUE_DATE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(ECD.APPLY_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "APPLY_DATE" ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NULLIF(ECD.END_DATE, ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE" FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD LEFT JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = ECD.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON FM.FTA_CODE = ECD.FTA_CODE AND FM.DELETE_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CD.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'NA' AND CD.CODE = ECD.COO_NATION AND CD.DELETE_YN = 'N' WHERE ECD.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = #{divisionCode} AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = #{vendorCode} AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = #{COO_CERTIFY_NO} ORDER BY ECD.ITEM_CODE ,FM.FTA_NAME
choose.otherwise:
WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CAST(#{COMPANY_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT) AS COMPANY_CODE ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{divisionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS DIVISION_CODE ,NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{vendorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') AS VENDOR_CODE ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY(BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*') END AS ITEM_CODE_ARRAY )
SELECT P.DIVISION_CODE AS "DIVISION_CODE" ,P.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" ,IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC" ,FM.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME" ,IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,'' AS "RULE_CODE" ,'' AS "RULE_CODE_NM" ,NULL AS "RVC_RATE" ,'Y' AS "COO_YN" ,'충족' AS "COO_YN_NM" ,'' AS "COVER_DATE" ,'KR' AS "COO_NATION" ,'대한민국' AS "COO_NATION_NM" ,'' AS "NO_CODE" FROM ITEM_MST IM CROSS JOIN PARAMS P INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT FTA_CODE, FTA_NAME FROM FTA_MASTER WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N' ) FM ON 1 = 1 WHERE IM.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE AND P.ITEM_CODE_ARRAY IS NOT NULL AND CAST(IM.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.ITEM_CODE_ARRAY) ORDER BY IM.ITEM_CODE ,FM.FTA_NAME

mapper.select: WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY( BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*' ) END AS HS_CODE_ARRAY ) SELECT FR.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,HC.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,FR.RULE_CONTENTS AS "COMP_RULE" ,CASE WHEN FR.BD_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BD_RULE WHEN FR.BU_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BU_RULE WHEN FR.NC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.NC_RULE WHEN FR.MC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.MC_RULE END AS "RVC_RATE" FROM FTA_RULE FR CROSS JOIN PARAMS P INNER JOIN HS_CODE HC ON FR.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(HC.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FR.HS_CODE)) WHERE CAST(HC.HS_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.HS_CODE_ARRAY) AND FR.HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = '1' ORDER BY HC.HS_CODE ,FR.FTA_CODE ,FR.RULE_SEQ ,FR.CTH_RULE
SELECT CODE AS "CODE" ,CODE_NAME AS "CODE_NAME" FROM CODE_DTL WHERE CATEGORY = 'NO' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY SORT_NO
SELECT CODE AS "CODE" ,CODE_NAME AS "CODE_NAME" FROM CODE_DTL WHERE CATEGORY = 'NA' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY SORT_NO

WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CAST(#{COMPANY_CODE} AS TEXT) AS COMPANY_CODE ,CAST(#{PARAM_VENDOR_CODE} AS TEXT) AS VENDOR_CODE ,CAST(#{APPLY_DATE} AS TEXT) AS APPLY_DATE ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY( BTRIM(CAST(#{itemCodes} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*' ) END AS ITEM_CODE_ARRAY ) SELECT CAST(#{PARAM_DIVISION_CODE} AS TEXT) AS "DIVISION_CODE" ,P.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" ,IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC" ,FM.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME" ,IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,NULL AS "RULE_CODE" ,NULL AS "RULE_CODE_NM" ,NULL AS "RVC_RATE" ,'Y' AS "COO_YN" ,'충족' AS "COO_YN_NM" ,'KR' AS "COO_NATION" ,'대한민국' AS "COO_NATION_NM" ,'' AS "NO_CODE" FROM ITEM_MST IM CROSS JOIN PARAMS P INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT FTA_CODE, FTA_NAME FROM FTA_MASTER WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N' ) FM ON 1 = 1 WHERE IM.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE AND P.ITEM_CODE_ARRAY IS NOT NULL AND CAST(IM.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.ITEM_CODE_ARRAY) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD WHERE ECD.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = P.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.ITEM_CODE = IM.ITEM_CODE AND ECD.FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND P.APPLY_DATE BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE ) ORDER BY IM.ITEM_CODE ,FM.FTA_NAME
